original_description: Pablooo.club helps users search a large screenshot library of iOS, Android, and web apps, compare real product UI patterns, filter by app, screen type, and device type, display results in a carousel, and fetch individual screenshots for closer visual analysis.
summary_ja: iOS・Android・ウェブアプリの画面例を検索し、UIデザインを比較する。
limitations: 収録範囲・画像の利用条件・実動作・料金は未検証。
